text:
frank: Heads-up: onboarding run for `loris-ranker` shows ndcg@10 down ~2.1% on curated_holdout but mrr@10 up ~0.7%. This landed with the passage-trimmer change + new emoji/url normalizer. Anyone seen the same signature?
nina: Can you paste the exact command you used to run the bench?
frank: `./ci/eval_rerank --model loris-ranker --set curated_holdout --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10 --seed 202`
harry: Quick cohort summary I pulled: short-query head cohort ndcg +0.5% mrr +1.0%. long-doc tail cohort ndcg -4.1% mrr -0.5%. Looks like context loss on long passages.
rashid: Passage-trimmer reduced candidate snippet cap 300->220 in the PR to save tokens; that would explain it. Also the normalizer now collapses repeated punctuation and strips trailing bullets.
frank: I also noticed a tokenizer mapping tweak for zero-width joiners in the same merge - could be compounding effects.
eval-bot: scheduled-ablation: running matrix (snippet=300/260/220, normalizer=old/new, tokenizer=before/after, quant=fp16/int8). run id rb-3876. ETA ~22m. :hourglass:
nina: While we wait, please generate a small sample of regressed queries (top 30) and the before/after ranklists so we can inspect churn patterns.
harry: Done; attaching a short CSV: 18 queries show >3 position shifts concentrated in docs with trailing lists/appendices.
eval-bot: ablation completed. summary:
```
snippet=300 normalizer=old tokenizer=before quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4331 mrr@10 0.2179
snippet=260 normalizer=old tokenizer=before quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4298 mrr@10 0.2190
snippet=220 normalizer=old tokenizer=before quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4250 mrr@10 0.2208
snippet=300 normalizer=new tokenizer=before quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4315 mrr@10 0.2192
snippet=260 normalizer=new tokenizer=before quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4279 mrr@10 0.2204
snippet=220 normalizer=new tokenizer=before quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4233 mrr@10 0.2221
snippet=300 normalizer=new tokenizer=after  quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4308 mrr@10 0.2198
snippet=260 normalizer=new tokenizer=after  quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4261 mrr@10 0.2212
snippet=220 normalizer=new tokenizer=after  quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4203 mrr@10 0.2235
snippet=220 normalizer=new tokenizer=after  quant=int8  -> ndcg@10 0.4181 mrr@10 0.2246
```
nina: Clear signal: shorter snippet reduces ndcg progressively. The tokenizer-after mapping amplifies the drop when combined with the new normalizer. int8 makes it marginally worse.
rashid: Root cause hypothesis: trimming plus collapsing trailing punctuation removes signals used for mid-tail ordering (affects ndcg), while for some topical queries it boosts the most relevant snippet to rank 1 (hence mrr up).
frank: Proposed action: 1) revert tokenizer-after mapping for docs (keep normalizer), 2) evaluate snippet=260 as compromise, 3) add per-query churn + delta-ndcg CSV to the PR for fast triage.
harry: I'll run the snippet=260 + tokenizer-before canary on dedicated bucket and post results.
nina: Also adding a gating rule to onboarding: always ablate snippet-length + normalizer + tokenizer mapping + quant sweep before promoting.
eval-bot: hold flag applied to loris-ranker (reason: ndcg regression on holdout_longdoc >1%).
frank: Thanks all 609. I'll open the rollback PR and tag you for review.
